## Citation

To cite this package in publications, please use:

Betebenner DW (2026). _randomNames: Function for Generating Random Names and a Dataset_. R package version
1.7-0.0, <https://cran.r-project.org/package=randomNames>.

A BibTeX entry:

```bibtex
@Manual{,
  title = {{randomNames}: Function for Generating Random Names and a Dataset},
  author = {Damian W. Betebenner},
  year = {2026},
  note = {R package version 1.7-0.0},
  url = {https://cran.r-project.org/package=randomNames},
}
```
